title: the group chat
hook: a screenshot, a furious boss, and a whole weekend to wait.
setting: A long weekend in a busy city, an office tower you can see from your window.
tone: anxious comedy that turns into something braver

self.description: Good at your job, bad at keeping opinions to yourself.
self.want: To find out who did it, and to keep your job.

cast.name: Odette
cast.description: Brilliant, cold, and fairer than anyone thinks.
cast.want: To know if you're worth keeping.
cast.tension: you called her a fraud in writing

cast.name: Miles
cast.description: Funny, loyal, nervy. He was in the chat.
cast.avoids: Telling you he knows who did it.
cast.closeness: you eat lunch together every day

opening.title: The message

opening.title: The screenshot
opening.description: Thursday, Odette stopped saying good morning to you.
